trigger.transport: QWERTY Q uses the native UART8 Trig-1 frames
trigger.auto_repeat: repeated key-down frames do not create a new rising bitmap edge

service_policy.held_refill: one reserve block while either native pad bitmap group remains nonzero

boundary.proven: native renderer service continues beyond the former eight-block edge budget while a real pad state remains held, then stops deterministically
boundary.not_claimed: real-time 48 kHz throughput; host wall-time performance remains a separate optimization gate

github_actions.policy: Validate locally and publish with [skip ci].

safety: Official stock firmware ran only from local temporary storage. No firmware, project data, factory sample names, captured PCM, or modified firmware artifact is included.
